from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from mdata import RawRow, validate_rows


def _rows(triples: list[list]) -> list[RawRow]:
    return [RawRow(date=d, ticker=t, close=c) for d, t, c in triples]


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc01_drops_unusable_rows_keeps_later_duplicate_and_sorts(golden):
    given, expected = golden("mdata", "TC-01")
    result = validate_rows(_rows(given["rows"]), given["tickers"])
    assert isinstance(result, list)
    assert result == _rows(expected["rows"])


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_sample_rows_lose_the_blank_close_and_come_out_sorted(contract_sample):
    rows = [RawRow(**r) for r in contract_sample("mdata.RawRow")["rows"]]
    result = validate_rows(rows)
    assert len(result) == len(rows) - 1
    assert all(r.close is not None and r.close > 0 for r in result)
    keys = [(r.date, r.ticker) for r in result]
    assert keys == sorted(keys)
    assert len(set(keys)) == len(keys)
